title: odd-status-marker
description: The status marker of a timeline event or a step (Figma's Event marker and Step status): a circle with the built-in glyph for `status`, or its own content (a step number) while idle. Decorative: hidden from assistive technology, so the list and the words beside it carry the meaning. The `.odd-timeline` and `.odd-stepper` recipes size and colour it; alone it has its own look.
$comment: Slots: default. A child names a slot with "slot"; text and children without "slot" go to the default slot.

status.description: Idle: the content or a dot. Pending: a busy ring. Complete: a check. Failed: a warning glyph.
